The mechanism appears to involve a fatty acid-mediated interaction, where the compound may act as a ligand or modulator of the fatty acid binding protein, potentially influencing cellular processes in the CCRF-HSB-2 cell line. The evidence suggests a dependency on fatty acid metabolism, with the compound possibly functioning as a regulatory agent in this pathway.
